manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U} each odd-numbered turn with {4}{U}{R}{R} each even-numbered turn
description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat during your second extra turn.
